rav-sherevya.name: Rav Sherevya
rav-sherevya.bio: Babylonian Amora who raised questions before Abaye.
rav-sherevya.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and an attentive, questioning expression, a scroll open in his hands as if pointing out a difficulty to his teacher; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rav-acha-midifti.name: Rav Aḥa of Difti
rav-acha-midifti.bio: Babylonian Amora from the town of Difti, of the generation of Ravina and Rav Ashi.
rav-acha-midifti.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a sharp, probing expression, one hand raised as if pressing an objection; background of palm groves along the Euphrates.
